representativeSnapshot.kind: Supabase project with promoter Phases 1-5 and native ticketing v2 applied

rowCountQueries: ticket_sales by completed/paid/refunded state and USD payment total
promoter_checkout_shadow_attributions attributed rows without sale attribution
duplicate ticket_sale_attributions(order_id) rows (must be zero before the unique index)
service-role-only function grants for promoter financial commands
preflight.expectedAffectedRows: Adds server-only commission finalization, reversal, recovery, and reconciliation functions. No historical sales are backfilled and no existing financial records are updated or deleted.

execution.resumeStrategy: All financial writes use immutable idempotency keys. Re-running the migration or a webhook returns the existing attribution/ledger row rather than updating money.
execution.idempotency: ticket_sale_attributions(order_id) permits one attribution per ticket sale; earned and reversal ledger keys are deterministic; reversals calculate only the delta to the cumulative processor refund amount.

quarantine.strategy: No automatic historical backfill. Enable payable commissions only after preflight, then process newly verified Stripe events behind the existing feature flag.

constraints: Only paid orders with an attributed Phase 5 shadow record can create an attribution
The effective program-version and ticket eligibility snapshot are stored on the immutable attribution
Earned, refund, chargeback, and dispute-reinstatement rows are append-only and service-role-only
No implicit FX conversion is performed; the current USD checkout requires USD promoter terms
indexes: promoter_commission_ledger(originating_entry_id, entry_type, created_at desc) where originating_entry_id is not null
constraintsAndIndexes.validationPlan: Verify duplicate paid webhooks, concurrent finalization, percentage and fixed terms, partial then full refund, chargeback then dispute won, term change before/after sale, self-referral, revocation, and a service-role reconciliation query.

recovery.rollback: Disable event_promoter_payable_commissions_enabled. Preserve all append-only entries for finance review; do not delete or update them.
recovery.forwardFix: Use a new additive migration and compensating ledger entries for any proven financial correction. Never mutate earned or reversal rows.

queries: all four Phase 6 financial functions have service_role execute and no public/anon/authenticated execute
a repeated paid webhook produces one ticket_sale_attributions row and one earned ledger row
a partial refund followed by full refund produces reversals summing to the original earned amount
a chargeback and won dispute produce one linked negative and one reinstatement entry
get_event_promoter_commission_reconciliation totals reconcile with raw ledger rows
